comment.zh-CN: 主因是强风／侧风。10/27 14–20 时六个模式中三个认为中以上：欧洲模式阵风 37 节、侧风 20.5 节，日本模式估算阵风 53.3 节、侧风 31.7 节，美国 AI 模式估算阵风 51.6 节。但阵风超过 49 节的概率仅 0%，阵风超过 29 节的概率 100%，前后时段多数模式仍偏低，整体停飞风险评中。
comment.en: The main cause is strong wind/crosswind. On 10/27 14-20 h local, three of six models say Medium or above: the European model shows gusts of 37 kt and crosswind of 20.5 kt, the Japanese model an estimated gust of 53.3 kt and crosswind of 31.7 kt, and the US AI model an estimated gust of 51.6 kt. However, there is only a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt and a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt, and most models stay low in the surrounding periods, so overall disruption risk is rated Medium.

comment.en: The disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswinds. During 10/27 14:00–20:00, three of six models indicate Medium or higher: the European model shows gusts of 37 kt and crosswind of 20.5 kt, while the US AI model and Japanese model show estimated gusts reaching 51.6 kt and 53.3 kt with crosswinds of 28.4 kt and 31.7 kt, and a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt. In other periods, such as 10/25 08:00 to 10/26 08:00 where the airport forecast (TAF) shows a mean wind of 6 kt, the risk is Low.

Peak gusts across the models are 18.3 kt, the chance of gusts over 29 kt is 0%, and rainfall is light, so the disruption risk is rated Medium, easing to Low from 10/29.

comment.en: The main factor is dense fog/low clouds, but the disruption risk is rated Low. Although the US model forecasts visibility of just 147 to 744 m during 10/25 08:00–10/26 02:00, 10/26 08:00–10/27 02:00, and 10/27 08:00–10/28 02:00, leading the model vote to rate these periods as Medium, the airport forecast (TAF) for 10/25 08:00–10/26 08:00 shows visibility remaining at 4000 to 9999 m and cloud base at 1800 to 3200 ft, a clear discrepancy with the US model. Given that all models rate wind and rain as Low across all periods (maximum estimated gust of just 29.4 kt and 6-hour rainfall up to 4.2 mm), low visibility from a single model does not pose a substantial threat.

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風：機場預報（TAF）10/25 09–15 時短暫平均風 28 節、陣風 38 節，剛過中級門檻，美國模式陣風 37.2 節也判中；但側風僅 8.9 節，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%，其他模式多判低。10/28 09–15 時僅德國模式陣風 37.1 節判中，其餘時段皆低，整體評中。
comment.zh-HK: 主因是強風：機場預報（TAF）10/25 09–15 時短暫平均風 28 節、陣風 38 節，剛過中級門檻，美國模式陣風 37.2 節亦判中；但側風僅 8.9 節，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%，其他模式多判低。10/28 09–15 時僅德國模式陣風 37.1 節判中，其餘時段皆低，整體評中。
comment.zh-CN: 主因是强风：机场预报（TAF）10/25 09–15 时短暂平均风 28 节、阵风 38 节，刚过中级门槛，美国模式阵风 37.2 节也判中；但侧风仅 8.9 节，阵风超过 49 节的概率 0%，其他模式多判低。10/28 09–15 时仅德国模式阵风 37.1 节判中，其余时段均低，整体评中。
comment.en: Strong wind is the main factor: the airport forecast (TAF) shows a temporary mean wind of 28 kt with gusts of 38 kt on 10/25 09–15 h local, just above the Medium threshold, and the US model's 37.2 kt gusts also rate Medium; but the crosswind is only 8.9 kt, there is a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt, and most other models say Low. On 10/28 09–15 h local only the German model rates Medium with 37.1 kt gusts; all other periods are Low, so overall disruption risk is Medium.

comment.zh-TW: 強風是未來五天的主要風險，整體停飛風險為中。依據機場預報（TAF），10/25 09–15 時平均風 28 節、陣風達 38 節，美國模式同期間也報陣風 37.2 節，歐洲系集顯示陣風超過 29 節的機率為 42%。其餘時段各模式多評為低風險，僅 10/28 03–15 時德國模式與美國 AI 模式有約 36 至 37.1 節的陣風或估算陣風，但多數模式未達門檻。
comment.zh-HK: 強風是未來五天的主要風險，整體停飛風險為中。依據機場預報（TAF），10/25 09–15 時平均風 28 節、陣風達 38 節，美國模式同期間也報陣風 37.2 節，歐洲系集顯示陣風超過 29 節的機率為 42%。其餘時段各模式多評為低風險，僅 10/28 03–15 時德國模式與美國 AI 模式有約 36 至 37.1 節的陣風或估算陣風，但多數模式未達門檻。
comment.zh-CN: 强风是未来五天的主要风险，整体停飞风险为中。依据机场预报（TAF），10/25 09–15 时平均风 28 节、阵风达 38 节，美国模式同期间也报阵风 37.2 节，欧洲系集显示阵风超过 29 节的概率为 42%。其余时段各模式多评为低风险，仅 10/28 03–15 时德国模式与美国 AI 模式有约 36 至 37.1 节的阵风或估算阵风，但多数模式未达门槛。
comment.en: Strong winds are the main factor over the next five days, bringing a Medium overall disruption risk. Based on the airport forecast (TAF), 10/25 09:00–15:00 has a mean wind of 28 kt and gusts reaching 38 kt, while the US model also predicts 37.2 kt gusts and the European ensemble shows a 42% chance of gusts over 29 kt. Other periods are rated Low by most models, with only the German model and US AI model showing gusts or estimated gusts of about 36 to 37.1 kt during 10/28 03:00–15:00, though the majority of models remain below the threshold.

comment.en: The main cause is strong wind and crosswind. In the two periods on 10/28 03:00-15:00, three of six models say Medium or above: the US AI model shows an estimated gust of 40.8 kt and crosswind of 35.4 kt, the US model a crosswind of 30.1 kt, and the European AI model a crosswind of 28.2 kt; for 09:00-15:00 there is a 92% chance of gusts over 29 kt, but a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt. The airport forecast (TAF) shows mean wind of at most 18 kt over the first two days, and rainfall is small in all other periods, so the overall rating is Medium.

comment.en: Disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswinds. During 10/28 03:00–15:00, three of six models indicate Medium or above: the US AI model projects estimated gusts of 40.8 kt and crosswinds of 35.4 kt, the US model shows gusts of 32.9 to 34 kt and crosswinds of 29.5 to 30.1 kt, and the European AI model shows estimated gusts of 34.8 kt and crosswinds of 28.2 kt. During 10/28 09:00–21:00, the chance of gusts over 29 kt reaches 92%, while the chance of gusts over 49 kt is 0%. Risk is Low for all other periods.
